blocks.text: Atasha Muhlach has again denied rumors that she had a romantic relationship with Jacob Ang, clarifying that they have always been good friends. The actress addressed the speculation during TV5’s “Tara Sa Paskong Kapatid” Thanksgiving Party in Taguig City, on Monday, Nov. 9. “Friends lang po. Friends lang po talaga,” she told reporters when asked about social media rumors claiming that she and Jacob, the youngest son of business tycoon Ramon Ang, had a relationship but recently called it quits. Muhlach also denied that she and Jacob had ever been romantically involved, despite previous sightings of them together, including at the […]...
